candidates.title: Shared-paper-first dollar-neutral news-propagation pair-sleeve build consuming the first measurement_ready first-seen batch
candidates.hypothesis: Build the single contract-mandated default-off shared-paper pair sleeve that consumes the exp-20260824-001 single-use qualification now that the d-0003 conversion gate is open: every measurement_ready first-seen batch (first real one: news-first-seen-845025fae409b81adeb3, frozen 2026-08-27T03:07:27Z with 29/29 PIT indicative borrow coverage) is mechanically admitted as ONE dollar-neutral paper basket - long the negative-polarity exposure rows, short the positive-polarity rows, equal row weight within each side, $1,000 per leg - entered synchronously at the first regular-session open strictly after batch first_seen_at with fail-closed missing-leg handling, exited at the 10th session close, charged frozen 45bp/leg round-trip costs, and judged ONLY by its own pre-registered forward acceptance contract (>=20 closed baskets over >=10 decision dates, net total PnL after costs positive, both chronological halves positive, single-ticker absolute gross contribution <=40%).

provenance.baseline_policy: hold the dollar-neutral zero position (cash) over the identical next-open-to-10-session-close window for every admitted basket; the basket PnL after frozen costs is measured against that zero and against SPY/QQQ same-capital comparators in the settlement rows
provenance.price_clock: batch first_seen_at precedes next-regular-session-open entry by construction; settlement at the tenth session close from the canonical warehouse with the massive_history broad-universe fallback for microcap short-side tickers

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The zero-cost prior treats theme-peers of negative-event and positive-event names as identically priced exposures, while the exp-20260824-001 qualified 983-row read showed negative-event peers out-settle positive-event peers by 152.0bp event-level / 189.0bp row-mean over 10 sessions - clearing the frozen 100bp/45bp two-leg cost bars for the first time, with much of the widening coming from the positive control side deteriorating, which is exactly and only the dollar-neutral pair construct. This build converts that single-use qualification into a default-off forward paper sleeve; it asks no new historical question.

transmission.catalyst: A first-seen exposure batch whose two polarity sides are dense, disjoint, concentration-capped, and fully covered by point-in-time indicative borrow evidence at admission time.
transmission.expected_direction: Long negative-polarity peer baskets out-settle short positive-polarity peer baskets by more than the frozen 90bp two-leg round-trip cost on forward batches.
transmission.half_life: From the batch first_seen_at next regular session open through the tenth following session close.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The effect is a diffuse second-order cross-sectional rotation one join away from the news with inverted polarity relative to naive sentiment; per-name notionals are tiny, half the qualified separation lives in the short side of low-attention peers, and monetizing it requires simultaneously carrying dozens of small two-sided positions with borrow checks - unattractive to discretionary traders and below institutional capacity floors. The sleeve stays default-off paper; no capital moves.
candidates.falsifier: The build itself fails closed (recorded as build-blocked, not as alpha evidence) if the admitted batch cannot produce one immutable basket decision row under the frozen contract, if either leg cannot be fully priced at entry (fail-closed missing-leg), if re-running the daily path double-admits the same first_seen_batch_id, or if replay and daily paths disagree on a representative basket. The SLEEVE is later rejected by its own frozen forward acceptance contract if, at >=20 closed baskets over >=10 decision dates, net total PnL after 45bp/leg round-trip costs is not positive, either chronological half is non-positive, or any single ticker exceeds 40% of aggregate absolute gross contribution; no interim read may relax those bars, re-slice by relation_type, or convert the pair into a long-only tilt.

baseline.policy: Zero position (cash) over the identical basket windows; SPY and QQQ same-capital holds recorded per settlement row as replacement comparators.
baseline.universe: Every measurement_ready first-seen batch in data/non_ohlcv/news_propagation_pair_forward_readiness/ from this build forward; blocked batches are never admitted.

treatment.policy: Mechanically admit each measurement_ready batch as one dollar-neutral basket: long negative-polarity rows / short positive-polarity rows, equal row weight within side, $1,000 per leg, synchronous entry at the first regular-session open strictly after first_seen_at, fail-closed if either leg cannot be fully priced, exit at the 10th session close, 45bp/leg round-trip frozen costs, default-off with no OrderIntent.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash (zero position) primary; SPY and QQQ same-window equal-capital holds recorded per basket settlement row.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: Admission requires the readiness record's 29/29 point-in-time iBorrowDesk indicative coverage (archived_at <= first_seen_at, <=3 calendar days); iBorrowDesk is indicative research evidence and NOT a broker locate, which alone caps this sleeve at default-off paper until a real locate contract exists.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: $1,000 per leg / $2,000 gross per basket paper notional; per-ticker notional is a few tens of dollars, far below any liquidity floor.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Frozen 45bp per leg round trip (90bp per basket) inherited unchanged from the qualification's viability bars; no borrow fee carry is charged in paper because the indicative fee is recorded per admission for later stress.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: US common stock paper positions on both sides; no options, no leverage.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Entry open and 10th-session close must exist in the canonical warehouse or the massive_history broad-universe archive for every row of both legs; a basket that cannot fully price both legs stays pending and never partially settles.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: first_seen_at is frozen before the entry session opens by construction of the exposure observer; the sleeve never enters on the batch freeze session itself.

prediction.confidence_reason: The build converts an already-qualified single-use viability verdict (exp-20260824-001: event-level 152.0bp > 100bp, row-mean 189.0bp > 45bp, all five confirmation bars held) into a default-off forward sleeve, so success here means the build stands up and admits the first real measurement_ready batch idempotently with parity - a mostly mechanical claim; the main disconfirming risks are microcap short-side tickers missing warehouse/massive bars at entry (fail-closed pending baskets) and the forward acceptance contract stalling if measurement_ready batches arrive too rarely, neither of which falsifies the mechanism but both of which would park the sleeve.

candidates.reopen_condition: Consumes the exp-20260824-001 single-use pair-build qualification and the d-0003 conversion gate opened by the 2026-08-27 measurement_ready batch; any FURTHER attribution re-read of the family requires >=1508 closed negative-side out-of-replay rows per the synced reopen lane.
candidates.next_machine_action: Reserve one candidate_pool_full_stack experiment, build quant/news_propagation_pair_paper_sleeve.py (shared replay + daily snapshot + settlement + parity + run.py default-off wiring), admit the ready batch, and freeze the forward acceptance contract in the closeout artifact.
